arguments.question: Assess ANET’s policy and geopolitical exposure over the 5-, 21- and 63-session horizon. Substantively review the latest filing passages on geography, customers and supply chain together with the January 15, 2026 BIS advanced-computing rule. Distinguish direct disclosed ANET exposure from second-order effects through hyperscaler AI deployments, semiconductor availability, tariffs/export controls and manufacturing/logistics in Asia or Mexico. Determine whether any revenue is already excluded from company guidance versus merely an optional upside/downside channel; do not infer applicability of a semiconductor rule to networking equipment without evidence. Deliver dated facts, conditional mechanisms, competing explanations, and observable review conditions. Stop after the supplied filing and rule; if geographic revenue, supplier weights, tariff sensitivity or subsequent legal changes are unquantified, record them as bounded gaps rather than searching repeatedly.
arguments.decision_impact: Defines whether policy/export-control or supply-chain developments materially alter ANET’s near-term business and valuation thesis, while preventing unsupported claims of direct China-rule exposure or policy upside.
